authority_classes.label: Binding legal authority
authority_classes.definition: Primary or delegated law, binding precedent, or other source whose legal effect binds within a stated jurisdiction and temporal context.

authority_classes.label: Persuasive authority
authority_classes.definition: Legal reasoning or decisions that may influence but do not bind the deciding body in the matter.

authority_classes.label: Procedural material
authority_classes.definition: Rules, practice directions, forms, fees and operational requirements governing legal process.

authority_classes.label: Delegated administrative rules
authority_classes.definition: Regulatory rulebooks, directions, determinations and schemes made under delegated competence.

authority_classes.label: Official interpretation or guidance
authority_classes.definition: Official statements explaining policy, interpretation, enforcement or compliance; force depends on statutory basis and context.

authority_classes.label: Legislative and judicial history
authority_classes.definition: Bills, debates, explanatory material, law-reform work, inquiry material and records evidencing development or intent.

authority_classes.label: Legal-service information
authority_classes.definition: Official information helping users access courts, tribunals, legal aid, forms, listings and public legal assistance.

authority_classes.label: Commentary or contextual material
authority_classes.definition: Non-authoritative or contextual information, including secondary databases and professional commentary.
